description: This file defines the DashboardInfoDao interface for accessing dashboard data, including methods for retrieving dashboards by tenant, customer, edge, and other criteria within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: DashboardInfoDao
classes.description: Interface for dashboard data access operations, extending generic DAO and container interfaces, providing methods to find dashboards by various filters.

methods.name: findDashboardsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards associated with a specific tenant ID, paginated via PageLink.

methods.name: findMobileDashboardsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards visible on mobile for a specific tenant ID, paginated.

methods.name: findDashboardsByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards for a specific tenant and customer, paginated.

methods.name: findMobileDashboardsByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves mobile dashboards for a specific tenant and customer, paginated.

methods.name: findDashboardsByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards for a specific tenant and edge, paginated.

methods.name: findFirstByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds the first dashboard matching tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findTitleById
methods.description: Retrieves the title of a dashboard by tenant ID and dashboard ID.

methods.name: findDashboardsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of dashboards by tenant ID and list of dashboard IDs.
